name: project-workflow
description: Plan complex software projects, require approval, then actively schedule native Codex agents with durable state and validation.

interface.shortDescription: Approve plans, then schedule native agents safely.
interface.longDescription: A durable workflow for complex software changes. It separates planning from execution, requires explicit approval, actively schedules native Codex agents with persisted DAG and write-scope controls, and records validation and delivery evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Project Workflow to plan this complex software change, wait for my approval, then actively schedule safe native Codex agents for the confirmed plan.
